name: lean
description: Fewer tokens at the same quality: a lean working skill, trimmed shell output, a cheap read-only scout agent and a handoff before the context grows large.

readGuard.title: Read guard
readGuard.description: Refuse a whole-file Read of a file over 400 lines once, pointing to Grep and a range; the same Read again goes through

testGuard.title: Test guard
testGuard.description: Refuse a full test-suite run once when the last full run in this repo was green and at most 15 files changed since, naming those files and their tests; the same command again goes through

agentModel.title: Model for search agents
agentModel.description: What general-purpose and Explore agents run on when the call names no model; inherit keeps the session's model

handoffAtTokens.title: Handoff at k tokens
handoffAtTokens.description: At this context size in thousands of tokens (200 = 200k) Claude saves a handoff brief, then the conversation is cleared or compacted; 0 is off

handoffResume.title: Handoff: carry on
handoffResume.description: After the clear, send the pick-up prompt instead of leaving it in the box, so a session nobody watches keeps working

handoffMode.title: Handoff: then
handoffMode.description: What follows the save: clear (empty context, the brief is read back) or compact (a summary stays)
